Priya: heads up, flight got delayed, need to pass primary for the 30m window. there's an active latency alert on embeds - see incident bot below. i'll shadow but can't be primary. @Noah? @Sam? :plane_arriving:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: LATENCY_SURGE detected on /v1/embeddings — p50=120ms p95=480ms p99=1.2s — impacted customers: 3 trials. severity: SEV3. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-surge
Noah: i can take primary for the window, pinging pager now. can you drop any sticky sessions or KV cache notes?
Priya: thanks, noah. prefix cache present for a few high-throughput customers (cust-a, cust-b). i left a note in the runbook section on cache eviction. quick commands below if you need to force a handover:
Priya: ```
# quick handover steps
# 1) set new primary in oncall-router
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/api/oncall/primary -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"primary":"noah"}'
# 2) evict prefix cache for affected customers
./kvtool evict --prefix cust-a
# 3) confirm traffic routing
./check-routing --route /v1/embeddings
```
Sam: +1 to noah taking it. i'll watch logs and handle paging escalation if it spikes.
Marta: i can help with quick rollback to smaller batch sizes and bump model variant if latency keeps rising. alerting thresholds are in runbook.
PagerBot: @Noah has accepted PRIMARY for thread 1749995432 — pager forwarded.
Noah: accepted. i'm running the handover steps now. will post status check in ~3m. Priya if you drop any last notes now that would help.
Priya: pushed one more note — avoid bulk cache eviction, target cust-a first. cust-b has live experiments.
Noah: got it. evicting cust-a prefix now.
Noah: eviction complete, routing check: /v1/embeddings p95 down to 220ms from 480ms. continuing to monitor.
IncidentBot: update — latency improving, p95=240ms, p99=700ms. no new customer errors. severity remains SEV3 pending stabilization.
Marta: i'm kicking config to reduce batch_size from 64 -> 32 for the affected pool. watch memory.
Sam: watching logs — no error uptick, traces show KV cache misses decreasing after eviction.
Priya: thanks team. i'm still on audio if you need me. i'll hand back primary once i land and confirmed no regressions. estimate ~2h.
Noah: noted, i'll keep primary and escalate if anything changes. tagging runbook checklist here for next ops: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-surge#handoff-checklist :thumbsup:
